//: Strict type-safety gate for src/. Node 24 runs these .ts files directly via type-stripping, so this config exists to ENFORCE the gate (tsc --noEmit); tsconfig.build.json is what emits.
//erasableSyntaxOnly: The dev/test workflow runs these .ts files through Node's type-stripping, which refuses syntax that is not erasable — an enum, a namespace, a parameter property. Without this flag tsc accepts all three and the failure surfaces later as a parse error from `node --test`, pointing at the syntax rather than at the choice.
//tsBuildInfoFile: Every config that extends this one MUST name its own: an inherited relative path resolves against THIS directory, so two projects would otherwise share one buildinfo and each would invalidate the other's.
